interpretation: The thesis independently documents the high-value controlled design: Ektachrome E100 and Velvia 50, two mock paintings, halogen and LED illumination, multiple exposures, 120-format reversal film, ten-band multispectral film scans and hyperspectral painting ground truth.

The public NTNU record exposes exactly one thesis PDF and one administrative attachment ZIP. The ZIP has two substantive declaration PDFs plus macOS metadata; neither the record nor the thesis links a separately downloadable film-MSI, painting-HSI, code or machine-readable data payload.

The retained deposit files carry only the Norwegian Copyright Act general-terms marker. Open download is not treated as explicit pixel redistribution or training permission. The thesis text also does not independently name E-6, so the process label is not backfilled from domain expectation.

The latest controlled study remains valuable literature and future acquisition guidance, but this public deposit cannot open pixel integrity, registration or operator fitting. No threshold, query expansion, PDF-figure extraction or rights inference is allowed as rescue.
next_leaf: Continue a distinct physical-film explicit-operator leaf using already eligible measured evidence. Reopen this route only if the authors or repository publish exact machine-readable film-MSI and painting-HSI payloads with explicit reuse rights.
claim_ceiling: papers-only controlled reversal-film design evidence and public-deposit data gap; no retained controlled pixels, stock response, scanner calibration, digital-to-film operator or product claim
